title: feat(nsopexft): nsopp x-probe formation-tick exist-opposite: reverse fails, face fails
science: Formation-tick exist-opposite on nsopp x-probes with all four S non-empty and no opposite pair: S(A)={+e1}, S(B)={+e3}, S(C)={+e2,+e3,-e3}, S(D)={+e1,-e1}. A clean double negative not caused by emptiness; the note names the cause correctly ('holding reverse and face needs the later tick').
